say.en: Suppose the marks are 310, 320, 330... Must we multiply such big numbers? No. Because of a useful property of r, we can shrink the numbers first and get the same answer. In this lesson: List the properties of r.
Use the step deviation method.
Recognise when r can mislead.

title.en: Properties of the coefficient of correlation

body.en: The *coefficient* $r$ has no unit and always lies between $-1$ and $+1$. It is independent of a change of origin and (positive) scale: if $u = \frac{X-A}{c}$ and $v = \frac{Y-B}{d}$, then $r_{XY} = r_{uv}$. It is symmetric, $r_{XY} = r_{YX}$. It measures only linear relationship, so $r = 0$ does not mean the variables are unrelated.
body.kn: r ಗೆ ಏಕಮಾನವಿಲ್ಲ, ಅದು −1 ಮತ್ತು +1 ರ ನಡುವೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೂಲ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾಪನದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯಿಂದ ಅದು ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದು ರೇಖೀಯ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; ತೀವ್ರ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳು ಅದನ್ನು ಬಹಳ ಬದಲಿಸಬಹುದು.

points.en: Unchanged by change of origin and scale
Can be strongly affected by extreme values

narration.en: The coefficient r has no unit and stays between minus one and plus one. Subtracting a constant or dividing by a positive constant does not change it. It measures only straight-line relationship, and a single extreme value can change it a lot.

title.en: Properties and the step deviation method

narration.en: The teacher lists the properties, uses step deviations to compute r, and shows a curve where r is zero.

say.en: Five properties to remember.

text.en: 5. r of X,Y = r of Y,X

say.en: X is 10 to 50 and Y is 15, 25, 20, 40, 50. Shift and shrink: u is X minus 30 over 10, v is Y minus 30 over 5.
Now sigma u v is 17, sigma u squared is 10 and sigma v squared is 34. So r is 0.92, exactly as with the big numbers.
But careful. Here Y equals X squared for X from minus 3 to 3. Y depends perfectly on X, yet r is zero, because the link is a curve, not a line.

problem.en: Using step deviations, find r for X: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and Y: 15, 25, 20, 40, 50 (take u = (X − 30)/10, v = (Y − 30)/5).

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Using step deviations, find r for X: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and Y: 15, 25, 20, 40, 50 (take u = (X − 30)/10, v = (Y − 30)/5).

say.en: Let us work this out together. Using step deviations, find r for X: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and Y: 15, 25, 20, 40, 50 (take u equals X minus 30/10, v equals Y minus 30/5).
u equals minus 2, minus 1, 0, 1, 2 and v equals minus 3, minus 1, minus 2, 2, 4; Σu equals 0, Σv equals 0.
uv equals 6, 1, 0, 2, 8, so Σuv equals 17.
Σu squared equals 4 plus 1 plus 0 plus 1 plus 4 equals 10; Σv squared equals 9 plus 1 plus 4 plus 4 plus 16 equals 34.
r equals 17 divided by the square root of 10 times 34 equals 17 divided by 18.44 is approximately 0.92.
So the answer is r is approximately 0.92 (high positive correlation).

heading.en: Shift or stretch, r won't budge

body.en: You may subtract any convenient number and divide by any positive common factor before finding r. The answer does not change, so always make the numbers small first.
